name: GSA (GSW=true) crossed with partner deal — no discount stacking
expected: A line that is BOTH GSW__c=true AND on a partner Deal_Type must NOT stack the GSA 50% halving with the partner percent: net must NOT equal 0.5*list*(1-partner%). Catalog also worded 'Net = ListPrice*0.5 (GSA only)'.
actual: On the fully-hydrated UI probe quote 00781388 (Perpetual line 0QLWC000003kbqs4AA, base=20000, partner=AB Test Channel-Originated Discount 15%) toggled GSW__c=true and Force-repriced (REST place, isSuccess=true): UnitPrice=177.5 (=ListPrice 355*0.5, GSA fired on the InputUnitPrice track) but NetUnitPrice=17000 = 20000*(1-0.15) = partner discount on the UN-HALVED base; Source_List_Price__c/Base_Price__c/Pre_Partner_Price__c all =20000 (waterfall hydrated). NetUnitPrice 17000 != stacked 8500 (20000*0.5*0.85): NO STACKING. GSA halved only UnitPrice, did NOT compound into the partner net. Restored GSW=false -> NetUnitPrice back to 17000 baseline. Fresh fixture 00781522/0QLWC000003kkCb4AI (clean list=20500) repriced to UnitPrice=10250 (=20500*0.5 GSA), PartnerDiscountPercent=15 RESOLVED, but NetUnitPrice=0 / Base_Price__c=null = the known headless Apex-inserted-line hydration artifact (same as D-04/E-01/E-02/E-03) -> uninterpretable for net, so validated on the hydrated probe instead.
evidence: Hydrated probe https://fortra--uat.sandbox.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/QuoteLineItem/0QLWC000003kbqs4AA/view (GSW=true: UnitPrice=177.5=355*0.5, NetUnitPrice=17000=20000*0.85, NOT 8500 stacked; restored to GSW=false net=17000) ; fresh fixture https://fortra--uat.sandbox.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/Quote/0Q0WC000003Fafl0AC/view (UnitPrice=10250=20500*0.5, pct=15, net=0 headless artifact) ; reprice logs Data/sc3473/e06/reprice_e06_result.json + reprice_e06b_body.json (isSuccess=true)
notes: V21 trace corroborates the empirical result. GSA mechanism (ListContainer1 seq12): gate GSAPricing (GSW__c Equals true) -> GSAPricing36 FormulaBasedPricing 'ListPrice * 0.5' -> output ONLY InputUnitPrice (surfaces as UnitPrice). Partner mechanism (ListContainer3 seq19): gate PartnerDiscount (Deal_Type__c != 'Fortra Originated' AND ItemIsDerived in {null,false}; NOTE: gate does NOT reference GSW__c, so on a GSW=true partner line it still FIRES) -> PartnerDiscount55 ManualDiscount with InputUnitPrice<-NetUnitPrice, %=PartnerDiscountPercent -> NetUnitPrice = NetUnitPrice*(1-pct). Container ordering: GSA(12) -> Sync InputUnitPrice for Discount Base(13) -> Stamp Base/Pre_Partner from Net(14) -> Resolve Partner %(15) -> ... -> Partner Discount(19). Decisive: NO V21 step seeds NetUnitPrice FROM the GSA-modified InputUnitPrice (every NetUnitPrice writer reads running NetUnitPrice / Base_Price__c / COLACalculatedPrice__c; 'Sync InputUnitPrice from Net' syncs net->input, not input->net). So GSA's halved InputUnitPrice never enters the net track, and the partner discount cannot compound on a halved value -> structurally cannot stack. EXPECTATION nuance (not a defect): the catalog's 'Net = ListPrice*0.5 (GSA only)' is imprecise on a partner line - GSA halves the UnitPrice/InputUnitPrice track while NetUnitPrice is governed by the partner discount off Base_Price (=list). The scenario's load-bearing safety assertion (no stacking, net != 0.5*list*(1-partner%)) is SATISFIED -> PASS. defect_provenance 'none / completeness-gap' confirmed: the cross GSW x partner produces no stacking and no procedure defect. Standing positive-control quote 00781388 was toggled GSW=true/false transiently and fully restored (NetUnitPrice=17000). Fixture: scripts/apex/setupE06GsaPartnerCrossTestData.compact.apex (+ Data/sc3473/e06/add_qli3.apex to add the BillingFrequency=Annual line).
verdict_reason: On a fully-hydrated GSW=true + Channel-partner(15%) line, NetUnitPrice=17000=20000*(1-0.15) (partner off un-halved base), NOT the stacked 8500=20000*0.5*0.85, and the V21 trace shows GSA writes only InputUnitPrice (never seeded into the net track) so stacking is structurally impossible -> the no-stacking requirement holds.
